notes:
• Operator, step two: the Operator is now a chat, on the Mac beside the overview and to-dos, on iPhone, iPad and Android with Chat and Status tabs. It runs on the Mac (Opus 5.5 at medium effort by default; Settings → Operator on the Mac), looks up what's open, reads a chat when you want details, passes your instructions to a chat, starts workspaces and keeps the to-do list. It never answers an agent's question on its own, only with your answer. A to-do added in the list goes to the Operator, which does small ones itself and starts a workspace for code changes; Settings → Operator turns that off.
• Operator, step one: a new first entry above all projects on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and Android. It shows every chat that needs you, failed, is ready or works, each in one line, and a to-do list you can add to, edit, check off and start a workspace from. After each turn a small model on the Mac (Haiku by default, Settings → Operator on the Mac, or off) writes that line from the chat's last messages, so the overview costs no tokens to look at. The Operator chat itself comes next.
• Stellwerk for Mac: "Check for Updates…" is now also in the app menu, below "About Stellwerk". iPhone, iPad and Android update through their stores or the download page, so nothing changes there.
